events.description: US counterterrorism operation reportedly kills Ayman al-Zawahiri in Kabul (reported 1 Aug 2022).
US raid on two al-Qaeda training camps in Shorabak district, Kandahar, described as among the largest since 9/11.
Claims by Hassan Hassan and others that Zawahiri was dead, which Roggio and Joscelyn disputed.
US withdrawal from Afghanistan complete; Taliban takeover.
Gen. McKenzie said US intelligence visibility in Afghanistan was 1-2% of pre-withdrawal.
Ahmad Shah Massoud assassinated by al-Qaeda suicide bombers posing as journalists.
State Department spokesman says US does not support armed resistance to the Taliban.
UN Monitoring Team report says Zawahiri is alive and al-Qaeda and the Taliban remain close.

key_claims: Zawahiri was sheltered in Kabul with the consent of senior Taliban leadership, likely Sirajuddin Haqqani.
The Taliban-al-Qaeda alliance remains strong and al-Qaeda advises the Taliban.
Key al-Qaeda allies in the Taliban's de facto administration have coincided with Zawahiri's greater freedom to communicate.
Sirajuddin Haqqani, as interior minister who controls passports and a reported al-Qaeda shura member, is the most obvious al-Qaeda ally in the Taliban.
US intelligence visibility in Afghanistan is minimal and the over-the-horizon center had conducted zero strikes before the Zawahiri operation.
Afghanistan under full Taliban control is a better safe haven for al-Qaeda than pre-9/11.
The US should support anti-Taliban resistance (NRF, AFF) to gain intelligence and a potential bridgehead.
